full_text:
The Mystery of Shadowing is the nineteenth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series. It takes place after Season 2. Although completed and advertised, the issue was cancelled and ultimately never published. A following issue was also pencilled but cancelled.

Synopsis

The Huntik team, now joined by Harrison Fears, travel to the snowy mountains of West Virginia to investigate the mysterious Mothman. There they face the wild Titan Shadowing and their old enemy, the Blood Spiral.

Triva

• Although this issue was never published, the comic itself was completed prior to the cancellation orders. One page shows the Huntik team on a plane, joined by Den and Harrison Fears. Another page shows Den and his Powerbonded Vigilante fighting against Shadow Kuolit.
